topic.title: Set Attributes, Properties and Notes at Translation Unit Level

body.p: Each <tu> element in a TMX document can store its own Attributes, Properties and Notes, independently of the file-level metadata described in Set Attributes, Properties and Notes at File Level.
Click on any cell of the translation unit that you want to edit to select it, then use one of the following options from the Edit menu.

section.title: Translation Unit Attributes
section.p: Select Edit Edit Attributes from the main menu.
The following dialog appears: Translation Unit Attributes Dialog
Adjust the text displayed in the text boxes, select the appropriate values from the drop-down selectors, and click the Save Attributes button.

section.title: Translation Unit Properties
section.p: Select Edit Edit Properties from the main menu.
The following dialog appears: Translation Unit Properties Dialog

ul.li: Click the Add Property button to open a dialog for entering the type and value of the new property to be added.
If you want to remove properties from the list, click the corresponding Remove Property buttons () on the leftmost column.
Click the Save Properties button to save your changes.

section.title: Translation Unit Notes
section.p: Select Edit Edit Notes from the main menu.
The following dialog appears: Translation Unit Notes Dialog

ul.li: Click the Add Note button to open a dialog for entering the text of the new note to be added.
If you want to remove notes from the list, click the corresponding Remove Note buttons () on the leftmost column.
Click the Save Notes button to save your changes.
